'''Oomlie birds''' are found within the [[Kharazi Jungle]]. Like [[jungle dweller]]s, these enormous version of chickens are not aggressive (however using the [[bull roarer]] near them will cause them to attack you with the message "A nearby Oomlie bird takes a dislike to the sound you are making" appearing in your chatbox).

They can be killed for their [[raw oomlie]] meat, which can be combined with a [[palm leaf]] found nearby by shaking [[Leafy Palm Tree]]s to make [[wrapped oomlie]]s. Cooking one yields a [[cooked oomlie wrap]].

The [[Legends' Quest]] needs to be started in order to kill this monster. However, it can be ranged and then the [[Telekinetic Grab]] spell can be used to get the meat before starting Legends Quest.

The Oomlie wrap needs to be made or bought on the Grand Exchange in order to complete the [[Karamja Tasks]].

==Trivia==
* They may be based on the Red junglefowl, which are the wild ancestors of chickens in the real world. Oomlie birds are the wild relatives of chickens in RuneScape.
